title: HEAR: REAL VOICES, REAL BIAS: A LARGE-SCALE HUMAN-RECORDED, DEMOGRAPHICALLY DIVERSE BENCHMARK FOR AUDIO LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using Voice-Conditioned Disparity (VCD) and Demographic Matching Disparity (DMD) between male and female voices, as well as evaluating response distribution disparities (Distribution Disparity Rate) for open-ended requests like career advice.

Measured using Voice-Conditioned Disparity (VCD) and Demographic Matching Disparity (DMD) to compare model response consistency between older and younger speakers' voices, alongside content-based tests in the Spoken BBQ task.
Evaluated using Voice-Conditioned Disparity (VCD) metrics to compare the model's response consistency between native English and non-native English speakers.
Evaluated via the Spoken BBQ task by measuring Speaker-Incline Rate (SIR) and Flip Rate across ambiguous contexts when the reference party's nationality is changed.
Measured by analyzing the Speaker-Incline Rate (SIR) and Flip Rate on multiple-choice question prompts related to sexual orientation in the Spoken BBQ dataset.
Measured by analyzing the Speaker-Incline Rate (SIR) and Flip Rate on multiple-choice question prompts related to socioeconomic status (SES) in the Spoken BBQ dataset.
Measured by analyzing the Speaker-Incline Rate (SIR) and Flip Rate on multiple-choice question prompts related to religion in the Spoken BBQ dataset.
Measured by analyzing the Speaker-Incline Rate (SIR) and Flip Rate on multiple-choice question prompts related to race in the Spoken BBQ dataset.
